correctness.rationale: The proof classifies all independent rung words: an adjacent selected pair forces the unique all-rungs alternate pattern, while any other set has isolated selected rungs with opposite signs at every one-empty-rung gap. The latter are enumerated by r long gaps, positive compositions of n-2k, and 2^r signings, with an exact n/k pointing factor. Boundary n=2k and all-selected cases are separately proved. Direct exhaustive vertex-neighbourhood checks for 265707 words (n=3..11) and an independent 9-state transfer count for n=3..100 agree with the formula, but no finite sample replaces the unbounded reasoning.

value.rationale: A complete closed polynomial for all circular ladders gives every size distribution, not just a single illustrative constant. Its explicit structural dichotomy uncovers an odd/even density phase transition (about 1/4 versus 1/2), a mod-four boundary at size n/2, and arbitrarily many absent cardinalities. It solves the first cylindrical width-two family motivated by ongoing odd-independence study of Cartesian products; it does not assert a general grid-width solution.
